# Sprinklr Interview Experience for Product Intern

Last Updated : 3 Apr, 2025

In Aug 2023, Sprinklr visited our college for an on-campus intern.  
Stipend: 2 Lakh per month  
Role: Product Intern  
There are total 4 rounds for the recruitment:

### Round 1: Online Coding Round

There are 3 question (Easy, Above Moderate and Hard) are as follows:

* No of Components in Undirected Graph (Similar as [this](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/number-of-provinces/1?itm_source=geeksforgeeks&itm_medium=article&itm_campaign=bottom_sticky_on_article) )
* Find K pairs with largest sum in an array and Required Time Complexity- O(nlogn)
* You are given a tree with N nodes where each node has an initial value. You will be given a number of queries, each specifying two nodes u and v, and a value x. For each query, you need to add x to all nodes on the path from u to v. After processing all queries, calculate the absolute difference between the initial and the updated values for each node, and sum these differences across all nodes.  
  This is super tough related to Binary Lifting   
    
  I solved 1st and 3rd completely and 2nd with TLE.  
    
  Result of Round 1: I got shortlisted

### Round 2: Technical Round 1

Started with the introduction then 1st question is related to Quick sort because of my sorting visualizer project.  
I answered all the question about this and he seems satisfied.  
  
2nd question : store the multiplication of last 3 maximum element of an array  
I had explained and coded 3 approaches, first with N^2log(N) then with Nlog(N) then with O(N)... then he moved to another question  
  
3rd question: [Multiply the strings](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/multiply-two-strings/1)To be honest, I got stumbled on this. I explained my first approach then he ask can I optimize it... I couldn't figure out how can I optimize so he said go ahead with your 1st approach  
again, I got stumbled (I dont know why I got hooked at very general question) I wrote the code but he didn't said to dry run.  
around after 45 min, Interview get over.  
  
Result: Not Qualitied for 2nd Technical Round  
  
About: Sprinklr selects only cream layer of students so be prepared and It doesn't care about your CGPA , resume or gender....spr

## ****Second round: Technical Interview round-1****

The interview started at 12:00 noon on Microsoft Teams and lasted around 43mins, there was one coding question and questions related to oops and dbms.

Coding question:

There are n houses and m roads connecting them, initially a house started burning you need to return the safehouse. Safe house is defined as the house that will not burn at all or the house that burns the last.

I could solve this using dijkstra algo and return the farthest node from the initial house that started burning. The interviewer was happy with the way I have approached the problem and the way I coded it up. He asked me for the time complexity and I have given the answer which is O(n\*logm)

Next, what is abstraction and polymorphism?

I have answered the correctly along with a real time example as well.

Then, he asked me if I knew about indexing in dbms?

I didn't know what it was and mentioned the same, he explained what it was. Basically it is like the contents page of a book at the beginning(similar to a map).

This was the technical round-1.

I've been informed that I was called for Technical round-2. Around 35 students were selected for round 2.

title: Words Added and Removed Between Sentences

reported.text: Given a previous and a current sentence, report which words were removed and added using the minimum number of edits (LCS on words), then optimise time and space.

sources.passage:
Sprinklr | Product Engineer, Gurugram | December 2023 | Oncampus placement   [Offer]
Oncampus placement at IIT.

First, there is an OA consisting of three questions-  first question is easy, second was of easy-medium type and third one was bit difficult one and has heighest weightege.
Whoever has done >=2 questions were shortlisted for interview.

Interview Rounds:
Interviews were in online mode (on MS teams).
Round1:
* Questions related to project
* Q1-Question finally comes down to -  Given two sentences (lets say previous_sentence and current_sentence of length n words and m words)- each sentence has many words. some words were removed from previous_sentence and some new words are added(some words may be same as removed but are added at different postions), as a result of these operations, current_sentence is obtained. We have to tell which words are removed and which words are added. The question finally reduced to finding minimum number of addition and removal of words. ( in best possible time and space complexity)
* Q2 - We have an array A of size n. we say array is good, if we can find three indices i<j<k such that A[i]>A[k]>A[j]. We have to check if array is good or not. ( final solution should be in O(nlogn) time and O(n) space)
* For both these questions, Interviewer also asked variations of these questions.

Round2: 
* Questions regarding internal structure of hashmap, then about collision and how to reduce collision without changing the hash function but can change  internal structure of hashmap( time complexity can be increased but better than O(n) in worse case ). Few more questions related to hashmap.
*  Some simple operating system concepts- semaphore, mutex locks, difference between them, virtual memory, context switch.etc.
* DSA Question:  we have a n cross m matrix. For example
0 0 x 0 0
 x 0 0 0 x
 0 0 0 0 0
 0 0 0 x 0
